kill_fact: The ECLIPSE 1 catalyst and the cash floor both survive primary-source checking. The two pillars this pass added to justify the edge do not. (1) THE TIMELINE UPGRADE IS FALSE AND SELF-CONTRADICTING. The dossier's headline improvement - that ECLIPSE 2 is no longer a Q1-2027 event, that 'both required trials finish at the same time', that 'the filing package assembles a full quarter earlier than published models assume' and 'the two-step re-rating collapses toward a single step', billed in consensus_delta as 'the third disagreement... and it is the most concrete' - is contradicted by the company inside the very press release the dossier cites for the ECLIPSE 1 date. Vir's 6 May 2026 Q1 release carries consecutive bullets: 'Topline data from the Phase 3 ECLIPSE 1 trial are expected in the fourth quarter of 2026' AND 'Topline data from the ECLIPSE 2 and ECLIPSE 3 trials are expected in the first quarter of 2027.' The dossier read a registry PRIMARY COMPLETION DATE (December 2026) as a topline-data date; they are different fields, and last-patient-last-visit necessarily precedes database lock, unblinding and topline. Because the same release states 'ECLIPSE 1 and 2 are designed to provide the registrational efficacy and safety data needed for potential submission to global regulatory agencies', the filing package remains a 2027 event and the re-rating remains two-step exactly as the street models it. The prior skeptic shard on this name recorded the same Q1-2027 guidance; this pass overwrote it with a registry misreading. (2) THE CORROBORATING VALUATION ANCHOR IS DOUBLE-COUNTED. The '$410 million in hard cash and equity' Astellas cheque - called 'the single hardest piece of evidence in the file', 'about 72% of the entire enterprise value', and repeated in sop_bull, consensus_delta, moderator_conclusion and the interrogator dossier - does not exist. The 23 February 2026 8-K, Item 1.01: Vir 'will receive $335 million in upfront and near-term milestone payments, INCLUDING $240 million in cash and a $75 million equity investment... and an additional $20 million near-term milestone payment upon completion of manufacturing process technology transfer, anticipated in the second quarter or third quarter of 2027.' The arithmetic is airtight: 240 + 75 + 20 = 335. The equity sits INSIDE the $335M, not on top of it; $315M lands around the 2026 closing and $20M is contingent on a 2027 tech transfer. Worse, and absent from every field of the dossier, Sanofi takes a cut: 'we will share with Sanofi 20% of certain future collaboration proceeds from the Astellas collaboration agreement' (Q1 2026 release, footnote 1), and the 8-K grants the license 'subject to certain intellectual property rights of Sanofi S.A.' with PRO-XTEN itself an Amunix/Sanofi trademark. The third-party mark is therefore ~$315M gross, ~$267M net of the Sanofi share - roughly 45-55% of enterprise value, not 72% - and the platform the moat rests on is in-licensed, not owned. (3) THE GOVERNANCE SIGN IS INVERTED. The dossier logs as a positive hidden signal that 'a new audit committee chair arrived on 9 June 2026... the board strengthened financial oversight ahead of a transition it knew was coming.' The 28 May 2026 8-K shows the opposite: Audit Committee Chair Saira Ramasastry resigned 25 May 2026 effective 26 May, an incumbent director was moved into the chair, and the board was cut from eight members to seven. The audit chair left, then the CFO left eight weeks later, leaving an interim principal financial officer on a shrunken board into the largest readout in company history. That is two financial-oversight departures, not a strengthening. WHAT SURVIVES INTACT, AND WHY THE VERDICT IS NOT REFUTED: ECLIPSE 1 (NCT06903338) is Phase 3, Active-Not-Recruiting, 124 enrolled, co-primary composite of HDV RNA below LLOQ with ALT normalization at Week 48, primary completion 31 December 2026 (Estimated), registry last updated 8 April 2026 - live, dated, registrational, un-fired and unpriced as of 28 July 2026, with the 5 August 2026 Q2 call as a cheap early checkpoint. The floor is filed rather than asserted: $809.3M of cash, equivalents and investments at 31 March 2026 (balance-sheet components $276.086M + $196.277M + $332.970M = $805.3M), total debt $95.579M that the Q3 and Q4 2025 balance sheets label capitalLeaseObligations, accumulated deficit $1.323B, runway guided into 2H 2028, financing completed in February, no ATM overhang, no going-concern, no CVR, no financing contingency. Own it as a single-binary Phase 3 with a real cash backstop - but not on the strength of a 2026 filing package or a $410M third-party mark, because neither is real.
corrections: CARRY-FORWARD GUARD, READ FIRST: the Q4 2026 ECLIPSE 1 topline guidance is LIVE AND CORRECT and must NOT be demoted to Q1 2027 - an earlier skeptic pass made that error off the stale 3 November 2025 enrollment release. Nothing below touches the ECLIPSE 1 quarter. MATERIAL (1) ECLIPSE 2/3 TOPLINE IS Q1 2027, company-guided, not December 2026. Strike the entire 'upgrade' framing from dated_milestone, forcing_function, consensus_delta (third disagreement), moderator_conclusion ('Better:' paragraph) and interrogator_dossier sections 2 and 7. A registry primary-completion date is not a topline date. A positive ECLIPSE 1 in Q4 2026 does NOT produce a filing in 2026; the submission package waits on ECLIPSE 2 in 2027, and the two-step re-rating stands as originally modelled. This removes the only genuinely NEW piece of edge this pass claimed. MATERIAL (2) ASTELLAS CONSIDERATION IS $335M TOTAL, INCLUSIVE of the $75M equity: $240M cash + $75M equity = $315M around closing, plus $20M contingent on a Q2/Q3 2027 manufacturing tech transfer (240+75+20=335). It is NOT '$335M plus a $75M equity investment' and NOT '$410 million in hard cash and equity'. Every instance of $410M and of '72% of enterprise value' overstates by ~30%; corrected, ~$315M and ~50% of EV. MATERIAL (3) SANOFI TAKES 20% of certain Astellas collaboration proceeds (Q1 2026 release footnote 1; 8-K license granted 'subject to certain intellectual property rights of Sanofi'). This appears nowhere in sop_bull, sop_bear, valley_of_death or consensus_delta. It haircuts both the ~$315M readout-date cash bridge and the ~$3.50/share VIR-5500 carry, and it undercuts the moat claim that the masking platform is Vir's own - PRO-XTEN is an Amunix/Sanofi trademark, in-licensed. MATERIAL (4) GOVERNANCE SIGN FLIP: the Audit Committee chair RESIGNED 25 May 2026 effective 26 May and the board shrank 8 to 7; no new chair 'arrived' to strengthen oversight. Combined with the CFO resignation this is a negative signal, not the charitable positive the dossier records. MINOR (a) CFO Jason O'Byrne informed the company 20 July 2026 and steps down effective 3 AUGUST 2026 - the dossier's 'announced 24 July 2026, effective 23 July' is wrong (24 July is the 8-K filing date; 23 July is the date the board appointed the interim). Brent Sabatini is interim principal financial officer effective 3 August 2026. MINOR (b) ECLIPSE 3 is PHASE 2b, a head-to-head vs bulevirtide 'designed to provide important supportive data to help establish access and reimbursement' - not registrational. Drop 'all three registrational trials'; all three are still confirmed closed to enrollment, so the enrollment-risk point survives. MINOR (c) THE FEBRUARY OFFERING SHARE COUNT, not the proceeds, is the wrong number - and this corrects a prior skeptic pass in the other direction. The Q1 2026 release states gross proceeds of $172.5 million, so the over-allotment WAS exercised, implying ~20,294,116 shares at $8.50, not the 17,647,058 base deal. Dilution was ~12.6%, not 11%. Use $172.5M gross AND ~20.3M shares together. MINOR (d) the company reports $809.3M of cash, equivalents and investments at 31 March 2026; the dossier's $805.3M is the sum of the three balance-sheet lines. MINOR (e) 161,234,058 shares were outstanding at the 31 March 2026 record date per the annual-meeting 8-K, versus the 168.7M used for per-share math; the filed count RAISES net cash per share, so this one cuts the bull's way and also implies market cap nearer $1.42B than $1.48B. MINOR (f) SOLSTICE per the primary source is 77% (24/31) TND at Week 72 rising to 88% (21/24) at Week 96 in the evaluable subset; the '66% at week 48' anchor is not corroborated in the Q1 2026 release, and n=24-31 evaluable denominators are far thinner than 'the identical regimen has already produced the answer' implies. MINOR (g) the Astellas equity was struck at $10.36, explicitly 'a 50% premium of the 30-day volume weighted average price... as of February 17, 2026' - implying a ~$6.91 VWAP. That is a negotiated strategic premium, not an arm's-length market mark on the stock; the 7,239,382 shares carry a one-year lockup from closing plus later registration rights, a post-catalyst overhang. WHAT I COULD NOT BREAK: catalyst_status PENDING_HARD is correct. The floor arithmetic in this pass (three quarters of burn to ~$800M gross, ~$4.15/share net cash) is now internally consistent and matches an independent recomputation. The finance-lease character of the $95.6M 'debt' is confirmed by the Q3/Q4 2025 balance sheets labelling the identical balance capital-lease obligations. No slippage language has been published since 6 May 2026.

Vir Biotechnology Form 8-K filed 23 February 2026, earliest event 19 February 2026, Item 1.01 (accession 0001628280-26-010740): 'Vir Bio will receive $335 million in upfront and near-term milestone payments, including $240 million in cash and a $75 million equity investment pursuant to a separate Stock Purchase Agreement... and an additional $20 million near-term milestone payment upon completion of manufacturing process technology transfer, anticipated in the second quarter or third quarter of 2027'; 'up to $1.37 billion in future development, regulatory and sales milestones, along with tiered, double-digit royalties on ex-U.S. net sales'; 'Global clinical development costs will be shared 40% by Vir Bio and 60% by Astellas'; the license is granted 'subject to certain intellectual property rights of Sanofi S.A.'; Astellas purchases 7,239,382 shares at $10.36, 'equal to a 50% premium of the 30-day volume weighted average price of a share of Common Stock as of February 17, 2026', with standstill, voting and one-year lockup provisions; 'Under the terms of Vir Bio's licensing agreement with Sanofi, Vir Bio will share a portion of certain collaboration proceeds received from Astellas with Sanofi.' 240 + 75 + 20 = 335 confirms the $75M equity is inside the $335M, so the file's '$410 million' double-counts it.

NCT06903338 (ECLIPSE 1): 'A Phase 3 Randomized, Open-Label Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Tobevibart + Elebsiran Combination Therapy in Participants With Chronic HDV Infection', sponsor Vir Biotechnology, Active-Not-Recruiting, 124 participants, co-primary HDV RNA below LLOQ with normal ALT at Week 48 for Arm 1 versus Week 12 for Arm 2 plus safety through Week 12, start 12 March 2025 (Actual), primary completion 31 December 2026 (ESTIMATED), completion May 2031, last update posted 8 April 2026.
